reviews.text: Heather and her team are AMAZING! If would recommend her to anyone who has a fur baby, or even considering getting one. I reached out to after already having my puppy and I was struggling with potty training with him. Heather, was patient, detailed and informative over the phone of what her training consisted of. I appreciated not feeling rushed over the phone, her willingness to answer my questions. Thank you for all that you do!

I can’t say enough good things about All Dogs Training Co in Waller. 👏I was initially nervous to leave my 2 11 week old doodle pups for 3 weeks of training, but after visiting with Heather & Matt, I was confident that I was making the right decision. While there, I received weekly updates & videos and was so pleased to see how they were progressing. Afterwards, Heather & Mike “trained” me on what needs to be done at home to reinforce their newly learned skills. They are now happy pups, eager to please & continuing to work on the expectations I have for them.♥️ I’m a happy doodle mom, too! 😃
Heather & Matt,
Thank you so much for your patience with them & me!!😊

Samantha, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We’re thrilled you had a great experience and truly appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again soon—please feel free to reach out if there’s anything we can do for you.
I took my puppy to them and they did a fantastic job with him.   I was impressed enough to sign him up for advanced training once he gets a little older.
We had a great experience with All Dogs Training Co. Definitely recommend!

Thank you, Megan — we appreciate the 5-star rating and your support. We're glad you had a positive experience and look forward to serving you again. If you need anything in the future, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Heather and Matt were great with our puppy!   They sent us pictures and videos and worked with us at both pick ups. We could tell how comfortable and happy he was while he was there.  We’ll definitely be back for additional boarding and training.

I'm so thankful that I found All Dogs Training online. Before then my German Shepard (Prince) and I were clinging to eachother. I couldn't leave him at home alone. He would bark  until my return. He'd lead me on walks and me hoping we didn't meet other dogs because he's easily distracted.  After two weeks with Heather and Matt training, walking him on a leash is a breeze now. The way he handles seeing other dogs now is incredible to witness. He stays focus on our walks.

His kennel manners have improved tremendously. Kennel breaks he now take naps while I get things done around the house. Even his clinginess has almost disappeared.

He is such a calm, well-behaved guy now, and it's all thanks to you and your team. We truly appreciate everything you've done for him!

My wife Leslie and I had an outstanding experience working with Heather at All Dogs Training Company. Originally, we were set on getting a silver lab with blue eyes, but after spending time with Heather and doing more research, she helped us realize that a traditional Labrador would be a much better fit for our family. She took the time to really educate us—not just on the breed, but on what to look for in a dog based on our lifestyle.

Heather went above and beyond throughout the entire process. She worked with multiple breeders to help us find the right puppy and ultimately found us a male yellow/white lab that was exactly what we were looking for. What really stood out was her level of involvement—while we were out of town on vacation, she personally selected the puppy, gave us her honest recommendation on which one would fit us best, picked him up, and immediately got him started in puppy training.

By the time we got back, we already had a great foundation in place, and we absolutely love our dog. He’s doing great, and we’re planning to continue with off-leash training when he’s six months old.

Heather has continued to check in with us and has been incredibly helpful even after everything was said and done. The entire experience was seamless, professional, and honestly exceeded our expectations. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for help finding and training the right dog for their family.
Heather and Matt were amazing with our Doodle. She did 2 weeks of training and learned so much. When we picked her up, they trained us on further training.

Heather and Matt did an awesome job with our 10 month old Portuguese Water Dog pup. They did a great job setting us up for success once we took her home too. We will definitely be back for any additional training both with this pup or the next.

We sent our 3-year-old yellow Labrador Retriever, Bosco, for a two-week training program to help with his leash pulling and overall anxious mindset, and the results have been incredible. Before training, Bosco had a hard time relaxing and often showed obsessive, restless behaviors.

After just two weeks, the transformation is amazing. He is so much calmer, more relaxed, and able to settle down and truly rest. His leash manners have improved tremendously, and he seems to have a much healthier, more balanced mindset overall.

It’s honestly crazy how much progress Bosco and the trainer were able to achieve in such a short time. We are so grateful for the care, patience, and expertise that went into helping him. Seeing him finally able to relax and enjoy life without constant anxiety means the world to us. We highly recommend this training program to anyone looking to help their dog build confidence and better behavior.

When I finally reached my breaking point—completely exhausted and out of ideas—I knew it was time to call in the true professionals. I have two powerful guardian breeds, and from day one, they were the ones running the show, not me.
But everything changed the moment I reached out to All Dogs Training Co. Their team was incredibly dedicated, professional, and attentive right from our first conversation. They truly listened, understood our unique situation, and crafted a tailored plan that gave me real hope.
I made the bold decision to entrust my girls to them for a full month of board-and-train immersion—and wow, the transformation was nothing short of miraculous! The dogs that came home are like entirely new companions: calm, attentive, responsive, and eager to please. They now obey commands flawlessly, respect boundaries, and our bond has never been stronger.
The relief and joy I feel now is indescribable—no more daily stress, chaos, or power struggles. If you’re at your wit’s end with your dog—whether it’s a guardian breed, a puppy, or any pup with challenges—do yourself (and your furry friend) a huge favor and contact All Dogs Training Co. They’re hands-down the best in the business, and I can’t recommend them highly enough to anyone, anywhere. Your life with your dog will be forever better! 🐾✨

I cannot express enough how great the change is in my dog! After his 4 week board and train program, I no longer worry about command control, behavior in public spaces, or leash control. This is a wonderful team of trainers!

We had a wonderful experience with All Dogs Training and are so grateful for the work they did with our Jade.

Jade is a rescue and came to us very timid with strangers, yet very rambunctious at home. Matt had the challenge of helping her feel comfortable while training her at the same time, which I know was not easy but he handled it with so much patience and professionalism.

After just one month with them, Jade came back home and the change in her behavior was incredibly noticeable. Her house manners improved a lot, she now lets us know when she needs to go potty, she reliably knows sit, place, and staying until I call her, and she no longer jumps on the furniture.

We also had a follow-up visit to get a refresher on how to correct our way of handling her during walks. Matt was very patient, showing us how to properly hold and work the leash, how to reward Jade, and how to make these experiences fun for our family and Jade.

He was also very patient in teaching us how to use the commands correctly and explaining the different types of collars and when each one should be used. But most importantly, Jade now knows how to learn  and that has made all the difference. We have already been able to teach her a couple of cute tricks using the methods they taught her, and I’m excited to see what else she’ll learn.

Highly recommend All Dogs Training to anyone looking for lasting results and a team that truly cares.

Heather and her staff couldn’t be better. Great experience for both our dogs starting with puppy training, extended board and train and boarding for when we are traveling inclusive of pick up and drop off. The dogs love Heather, Kayla and the entire staff. Great communication, excellent value and cannot recommend more!

I have had a fantastic experience with All Dogs Training C. My puppy Nanuq recently completed the two-week board and train puppy program, and returned for boarding over the holidays. Because of Heather and Matt, Nanuq now has a strong start with foundational obedience and crate training early in his life.

Before choosing All Dogs Training Co, I really valued the time Heather took to call me. She not only explained the programs and their training philosophy but also offered helpful advice on preparing for life with my first puppy.

During Nanuq’s training, I received regular video and progress updates, and we had a session before bringing him home. Matt and Heather have been fantastic with their guidance and tips – they make it look effortless! Of course, the training is as much for me as it is for Nanuq, ensuring we enjoy a wonderful life together.

I’m confident the relationship Heather and Matt have started will continue as Nanuq grows and moves on to advanced obedience and confidence training in the near future.

I highly recommend All Dogs Training CO. Thank you Heather and Matt!

We recently completed a 2-week puppy class with Heather, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience!
From day one, they created a welcoming and supportive environment for both puppies and owners. Their training methods were clear, effective, and always positive—focusing on building trust and confidence.
Our puppy made progress in just two weeks crate training, learning basic commands, socializing, exposure to new things, body handling, etc. What impressed me most was how Heather tailored their approach to each pup’s personality and needs. They were patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about helping dogs thrive.
We left the class feeling more confident as a dog owner and excited to continue building on the foundation we’ve created.

Before training, our Rottie would walk us on walks, which was embarrassing and not enjoyable. After his 2 week board and train, it’s so much easier to use the commands at home and outside- walks are now enjoyable for all of us!

Heather told us to reach out if we had any questions, and when we did, she responded right away with great advice that helped a lot. Arnold is doing so much better, and we’re excited to keep building on the progress.

Thank you for giving us such a strong start. We’re so grateful! Arnold says thank you too!

I had my 5-year-old European Doberman, Stein, trained at All Dogs Training Co. Stein was imported from Germany because I wanted strict breeding standards, quality, and a true working Doberman. As someone who travels overseas often, I needed a companion that could also protect my family while I’m away. Working dogs are much harder to train and keep, and despite having gone through two different training companies before, I was never satisfied. What I experienced with All Dogs Training was on a completely different level.

I’m the president of Cyrus Proximity and live and work in Houston, so professionalism and results matter a great deal to me. That’s exactly what I experienced with Heather and her team. Her trainers are calm, disciplined, and highly skilled. They don’t take shortcuts and genuinely care about long-term results. Stein is now calmer, more responsive, and noticeably happier — and in turn, so is our whole family. I also have two kids (8 and 13), so having Stein properly trained was extremely important for our family’s safety and peace of mind. My own training with the team changed the way I communicate with Stein, which has been transformative.

Beyond training, Heather also recommended changes to Stein’s food and shampoo. Not only did this save me money on his monthly expenses, but it also improved his coat, smell, and overall health.

It’s been three weeks since Stein completed his training, and I waited intentionally before writing this review to make sure I could see the lasting effects. I can confidently say the results have exceeded my expectations.

I wish I had known about All Dogs Training Co. five years ago. They are by far the best in Houston. Their background — including European training standards and instructors with military experience — shows in the way they work: professional, effective, and deeply committed to their clients. They truly care about the quality of their training, the results, and the ongoing support they provide.

I rarely write reviews, but in this case I felt I had to. I highly recommend Heather and her team.

— Reza Ganjineh

I was a little scared to leave our puppy there for 2 weeks but Heather was amazing about keeping us updated the whole way. We have a mini schnauzer puppy with ALOT of energy. She was jumping and nipping at us constantly. Decided to ask for help because we were at a loss. When we came to pick our baby up we saw that she was the same but so much calmer and relaxed. They started the basics with her and gave us clear instructions on how to continue it at home. She is doing amazing and we are considering sending her back when she is a little older to learn some more advance training. If you are on the fence don’t be. This was the best choice we could have made for her!

I cannot recommend Heather and the team at All Dogs Training Co. enough. We did the puppy course followed a few weeks later by the full training with off leash for our Blue Heeler. He is a wide open, high drive, high energy dog and he came home like a new dog. He still gets excited at play time but when he hears a command, or goes on walks he is perfect. We will definitely be sending any future dogs to train with the team at All Dogs and will be referring everyone who asks us straight to the front door of the facility.

All Dogs Training was amazing. Our Aussie did a 4 week training and came back a whole new dog! She is still her sassy, spunky self, but is able to place, calm down in her kennel, and be around others without snapping and getting overwhelmed.

I can’t say enough about Heather and Matt - they have been so patient through the whole training process. As a first time dog owner, they took extra time in training me (and I needed as much help as my dog!) and from the first phone call, Heather indulged all my questions, was honest about the training practice, and helped to dispel dog-owning myths without ‘selling’ her facility. She was just honest - and I needed that.
After the board & train program Livvie is like a new dog and is well behaved, but she remains sweet, playful and curious -  and only occasionally tries to push boundaries to see what she can get away with!  We are both still learning but I’m so happy I chose All Dogs - I don’t think I would have the same results and confidence elsewhere.
Great Experience! I highly recommend getting your dog training and using Heather.  My dog Penny is very well trained and obedient after the two weeks she was there.

10 stars would be more accurate.

﻿**Outstanding Dog Trainers for all dogs but our dog was a rescue Rescue**

I recently had the pleasure of working with Matt and Heather to train my rescue dog, Radar, and I cannot recommend them highly enough. The transformation we have seen in Radar thanks to their expertise and dedication is nothing short of remarkable.
From our first consultation, Matt and Heather displayed a deep understanding of canine behavior and an impressive ability to connect with dogs, especially those who may have come from challenging backgrounds. Radar was initially shy and anxious, showing signs of fear-based reactions to new environments and unfamiliar people. Matt and Heather approached the situation with compassion and patience, taking the time to build a bond with Radar that laid the foundation for his training.
Throughout our sessions, Matt and Heather employed positive reinforcement techniques that not only boosted Radar's confidence but also encouraged him to engage more playfully and openly. I appreciated their ability to tailor the training plan to Radar's specific needs, incorporating various exercises that focused on socialization, obedience, and desensitization to stimuli that had previously frightened him.
One of the aspects I found particularly impressive was Matt and Heather's commitment to educating me as an owner. They took the time to explain each technique and its purpose, empowering me to be an active participant in Radar's training journey. Thanks to their clear guidance and support, I feel more equipped to handle any challenges that may arise in the future.
After just a few weeks of consistent training, the changes in Radar were astonishing. He became more relaxed in new situations, learned basic commands like sit, stay, and come, and even started to play with other dogs. Watching him thrive has been incredibly rewarding, and I credit it all to Matt and Heather's skill and dedication.
In addition to their training expertise, Matt and Heather were always friendly, approachable, and responsive to any questions or concerns I had along the way. Their passion for helping rescue dogs and their owners shines through in every interaction, making the experience enjoyable and fulfilling.
If you're looking for dog trainers who truly understand rescue dogs and can help them reach their full potential, I wholeheartedly recommend Matt and Heather. Thanks to their incredible work, Radar and I are building a stronger bond every day, and I have all the confidence in the world that we are on the right path. Thank you, Matt and Heather, for your outstanding support and guidance!
Brad & Missy

Our over eager Goldendoodle puppy did great with Matt and Heather.  She now walks on a leash without pulling. Willow will sit at the door without running out.  She is much better at not jumping on people.  Willow still has a lot of puppy energy but she is much better at obeying commands.  We are very pleased with her progress.  Thanks Heather and Matt!

All Dogs Training is the absolute best! Heather, Matt, Amy and the rest of the team are both super skilled in dog training and incredibly kind and approachable. They have a true passion for dog training and their love for training and dogs is palpable.

My 4 yr old mini goldendoodle was enrolled in their 2 week board and train and came back a much more obedient and settled dog. Within the first week, he settled much more easily and showed immense impulse control. He went from excited jumping and barking, to treating other humans and dogs with a much more calm demeanor.

I brought him to a different training program as a puppy / young dog and I so wish I found All Dogs Training and Heather back then. From the first consult call, where Heather took 45 min out of her day to answer any and all of my questions, to the take home lesson where Matt and Amy diligently trained me on how to continue training at home - absolutely night and day from my previous experiences. They adapted their training to my dog, not the other way around. The team worked with me and made sure I felt comfortable, which unfortunately was not my experience with other dog trainers who picked apart any little mistake my dog or I made.

The team and programs at All Dogs Training are the gold standard. Run, don't walk, to All Dogs!

Choosing to use All Dogs Training was by far the greatest decision I have ever made (other than finally adopting my first dog!) They are the best and their support has been life changing for me and my dog. Heather and Matt are brilliant, experienced, kind, and phenomenal at this. In addition to the amazing train and board program, they have provided me so much additional support and guidance after the fact— they go above and beyond because they truly care. That is the difference between their team and a lot of the franchises out there. I will forever be grateful I found them! I can also trust the advice and wisdom they share and that’s such a relief for a new dog owner. I’d give them 10 stars if I could.

We’re so happy that we found Heather and Matt to send our puppy for their “foundation puppy training” . Our dog is now back home for about two weeks and thanks to the training and advice from Heather, it’s is much easier to manage his stuff and he has turned to a trainable dog. One of the best things about this company is that they spent a lot of time with you after the training to transfer the knowledge and teach you the commands. Heather was so nice that she actually came to our house for one of the lessons to address our questions and make sure we are doing things right. We’re absolutely happy about their service and highly recommend them. We’re looking forward to send our dog back to them for their obedience training once he is 6/7 months old . Thanks Heather and Matt . You guys are so professional and friendly.

We are VERY pleased with All Dogs Training. We were very nervous leaving Leo for 2 weeks but Heather communicated, sent pictures and videos. We received thorough written information in addition to the 1 on 1 training, before we picked up our dog to go home. Matt has a wonderful, calm and confident disposition. We definitely see great results now that we’re home! We’re very dedicated to practicing everything our pup has learned. It’s so wonderful having a well trained dog at home!
